provenance: Independently authored exact JSON text vectors. The json string is the wire input; do not normalize, round or reserialize it before a runtime/client check.
validationBoundary: schemaValid records only acceptance by the repository's existing limited schema evaluator and JSON parser. It does not prove duplicate-name rejection, exact signed-Int64 range, calendar validity, Jobs UTF-8 byte bounds, native catalog uniqueness/references or HTTP authorization/durability. The valid flag is the full wire expectation for actual C# and TypeScript consumer tests.
